codeReview.summary: Clean implementation that adds model parameter passing and an OpenCode-only engine guard to the SDK transport. The worker correctly investigated the @opencode-ai/sdk types, discovered that SessionPromptData.body.model accepts { providerID, modelID }, and implemented parseModelString() to convert config strings into that shape. The engine guard defaults to 'opencode' when engineName is omitted, preserving backward compatibility. Auto-detect correctly threads dispatcherModel through to SdkTransport. All 13 new tests pass alongside the full existing suite (2904 total). Typecheck is clean.

issues.description: parseModelString() does not validate empty string input. Calling parseModelString('') would return { providerID: 'anthropic', modelID: '' }. Not practically exploitable since the model is always resolved from DEFAULT_OPENCODE_MODEL or a config value, but a defensive guard (e.g., if (!model) throw) would be cleaner.

The 'passes dispatcherModel to SDK transport when using opencode engine' auto-detect test uses a conditional assertion (if result.label === 'cli') that only verifies the CLI fallback path. The SDK path is never actually exercised in this test since the mock spawner environment doesn't have a running OpenCode server. The comment acknowledges this, but a more robust approach would mock the server singleton to force the SDK path.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The SdkClient interface is extended in-file with model and tools fields rather than being generated from or aligned to the actual SDK types. If the SDK types change (e.g., SessionPromptData.body.model gains new required fields), this inline type will silently diverge. AGENTS.md doesn't mention a convention for keeping internal type mirrors in sync with external SDK types.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: flywheel-tui/src/dispatcher/sdk-transport.ts:75-83 — SdkClient.session.prompt body type is manually maintained, while the actual SDK types live in node_modules/@opencode-ai/sdk/dist/gen/types.gen.d.ts (SessionPromptData).

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker discovered that the @opencode-ai/sdk SessionPromptData.body supports a 'model' field with { providerID: string; modelID: string } shape, and also 'tools' with Record<string, boolean>. This SDK API surface knowledge is not documented in .factory/library/ but is valuable for future features that may want to control tool availability or agent parameters via the SDK.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Worker transcript shows investigation of node_modules/@opencode-ai/sdk/dist/gen/types.gen.d.ts to discover SessionPromptData shape. The 'tools' field was added to SdkClient interface but is not yet used in the implementation.

summary: PASS. The SDK transport optimization is well-implemented with correct model parameter passing via the SDK's SessionPromptData.body.model spec, a clean OpenCode-only engine guard that defaults safely, and proper auto-detect integration. Two non-blocking issues noted: parseModelString lacks empty-string validation (not practically exploitable), and one auto-detect test only verifies the CLI fallback path. The implementation fully covers all three validation criteria (VAL-SDK-001, VAL-SDK-002, VAL-SDK-003) with 13 targeted tests.
